name: Semyon Malamud
one_sentence_summary: Semyon Malamud is an EPFL Full Professor whose research fuses machine learning, high-dimensional statistics, and financial economics to advance asset pricing, portfolio theory, and market microstructure.
matrix_summary: Semyon Malamud has been promoted to Full Professor at EPFL and published two major journal papers (*Universal Portfolio Shrinkage* and *Signaling with Debt Currency Choice*, both in top-3 finance journals) alongside a significant new NBER working paper (*Infinite Factor Structure in Conditional Asset Pricing*) that challenges foundational assumptions of the arbitrage pricing theory using operator-theoretic methods. A new working paper *The Hidden Sharpe Ratio* also appeared.
